title: Plant Physiology
description: A tree lifts water a hundred metres with no pump. Capillarity alone raises it a few centimetres; the rest is pulled up from above, as leaves evaporate it and the water column, held together by its own cohesion, is drawn up the xylem under tension. Unlocks the Hydroponic Tower and Xylem Fibre.

puzzle.goal: Water climbs a narrow tube of radius r because it wets the wall: surface tension γ pulls it up at a contact angle θ until the column's weight balances it (Jurin's law). Write h, the height it rises.
puzzle.name: Jurin's law
puzzle.form: 2 * γ * cos ( θ ) / ( ρ * g * r )
puzzle.ask: Find h in m for a xylem vessel: γ = @{γ} N/m, θ = @{θ} rad, ρ = @{ρ} kg/m³, g = @{g} m/s², r = @{r} m. (A tall tree needs a hundred times more.)
puzzle.method: Upward force 2πrγcosθ round the meniscus; weight ρgπr²h of the column.
